description: Unify the Web AgentSession detail surface across Agent-launch and Workflow sources, then expose authoritative Session tracking and controls through its stable ID.

tasks.title: Complete the unified AgentSession read projection
tasks.description: Extend the source-agnostic Session summary and transcript read contract so a stable Session ID supplies all context, current-turn, input/turn, runtime-binding, usage, failure, recovery, and command-gating facts required by the Web. Keep source-specific associations absent when inapplicable and preserve project isolation; do not add persisted Session state or a new command path.
acceptanceCriteria: `GET /api/projects/{projectRef}/sessions/{sessionId}` returns the complete shared page projection for both `agent-launch` and `workflow` Session sources, including current-turn and input/turn observations, terminal/failure evidence, model/usage, recovery availability, and runtime binding.
The projection supplies only Agent identity for Agent-launch Sessions and only Workflow identity for Workflow Sessions; it does not serialize fabricated source associations.
Summary and transcript reads return not found for a Session in another Project or an unsupported source kind.
Server spec coverage verifies both sources, project isolation, absent source fields, current-turn observations, and transcript retrieval by stable Session ID.
tasks.output: Extended unified Session read DTO, querier, and route contract with source-aware Server spec coverage.
tasks.notes: Build on `UnifiedSessionSummaryDto`, `AgentSessionQuerier.GetUnifiedSessionSummaryAsync`, and `UnifiedSessionRoutes`; the Session domain remains the only owner of activity, turns, and bindings.

tasks.title: Deliver the stable-ID Web AgentSession tracking page
tasks.description: Add a typed unified Session API client and `useUnifiedSessionDataSource`, then route all Session detail entry points through `/sessions/:sessionId`. Reuse `SessionDetailShell` and the transcript widget to show source-aware navigation, chronological inputs, turns, transcript/tool evidence, usage, context health, empty states, and live authoritative convergence; remove the duplicate source-specific detail data sources and routes after call sites move.
acceptanceCriteria: Agent history, Workflow Session lists, and Issue transcript actions navigate to `/sessions/:sessionId` using the stable logical Session ID.
One shared data source renders both Agent-launch and Workflow Sessions without resolving a Workflow Session through an Issue-scoped session name.

The page presents source context before the transcript, groups each SessionInput with its AgentTurn, and displays input acceptance/delivery, tool or execution failures, resolved model, usage, and context health.
Active-without-content, idle-without-content, and unknown activity remain distinct; unknown observations never enable unsafe controls or fabricate accepted/terminal state.
Live terminal events and recovery-driven binding changes reconcile the unified summary and transcript while excluding stale runtime content.
Focused Web tests cover both sources, source-aware navigation, input/turn grouping, empty/unknown states, failure evidence, and live convergence.
`npm run typecheck -w packages/web`, `npm run test:run -w packages/web`, and `npm run check:fsd -w packages/web` pass.
tasks.output: A single stable-ID Web Session detail route and shared tracking data source with source-agnostic read behavior.
tasks.notes: Keep presentation dependencies downward under the Web FSD rules. Existing `SessionDetailShell` and `useSessionTranscript` remain the shared rendering and live-event primitives.

tasks.title: Operate AgentSessions from the unified Web page
tasks.description: Connect follow-up, queued-turn cancellation, active-turn stop, Compact, and Reset to the unified Session page through the canonical Session-ID APIs. Derive availability from the authoritative unified observation, retain a follow-up idempotency key only for unknown results, and invalidate or reconcile the shared summary and transcript after every command.
acceptanceCriteria: An accepted follow-up creates a SessionInput and AgentTurn on the existing logical Session without creating another Session or AgentJob; unknown follow-up results expose retry with the original idempotency key.

Cancel is available only for a queued current turn and reports terminal cancellation; stop is available only for an executing current turn and remains `stop-requested` or `unknown` until the Session reports a terminal result.

Compact and Reset are unavailable while a turn is queued or executing. Reset requires confirmation and, when accepted, retains the logical Session history while presenting the new empty runtime context.
Rejected, failed, and unknown command outcomes remain explicit, and every command refreshes the unified summary/transcript and relevant Session lists rather than locally fabricating success.

Focused Web tests cover idle and active follow-up, unknown retry identity, queued cancel, unconfirmed stop, active recovery gating, confirmed reset, and command-state reconciliation for both Session sources.
`npm run typecheck -w packages/web`, `npm run test:run -w packages/web`, and `npm run check:fsd -w packages/web` pass.
tasks.output: Unified Web Session controls with authoritative outcomes and regression coverage for follow-up, turn control, Compact, and Reset.
tasks.notes: Reuse the canonical `/agent-sessions/{sessionId}` command APIs and Session-domain decision rules; do not branch command dispatch by Session source.
